# SpectraWave

> A free, client-side toolkit for spectroscopy and photonics researchers: converts wavelength (nm), photon energy (eV, J), wavenumber (cm⁻¹), and frequency (THz), and plots multiple absorption or steady-state fluorescence spectra with waterfall offsets, a colorblind-safe palette, and publication-ready SVG/PNG export. Everything runs in the browser; no data is transmitted, no account required.

## Key formulas

- Energy (eV) = 1239.84198 / Wavelength (nm)
- Wavenumber (cm⁻¹) = 10,000,000 / Wavelength (nm)
- Frequency (THz) = 299792.458 / Wavelength (nm)
- Wavelength (nm) = 1239.84198 / Energy (eV)

## Reference values for common lasers

| Laser | Wavelength (nm) | Energy (eV) | Wavenumber (cm⁻¹) | Frequency (THz) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ArF Excimer | 193 | 6.424 | 51813 | 1553.3 |
| KrF Excimer | 248 | 4.999 | 40323 | 1208.8 |
| XeCl Excimer | 308 | 4.025 | 32468 | 973.4 |
| Nd:YAG 3rd Harmonic | 355 | 3.493 | 28169 | 844.5 |
| Diode (violet/Blu-ray) | 405 | 3.061 | 24691 | 740.2 |
| Argon-Ion (blue) | 488 | 2.541 | 20492 | 614.3 |
| Nd:YAG 2nd Harmonic (green) | 532 | 2.331 | 18797 | 563.5 |
| Helium-Neon (HeNe) | 632.8 | 1.959 | 15803 | 473.8 |
| Ruby | 694.3 | 1.786 | 14403 | 431.8 |
| Ti:Sapphire (center) | 800 | 1.550 | 12500 | 374.7 |
| Nd:YAG (fundamental) | 1064 | 1.165 | 9398.5 | 281.8 |
| Telecom InGaAsP (C-band) | 1550 | 0.800 | 6451.6 | 193.4 |
| Er:YAG | 2940 | 0.422 | 3401.4 | 102.0 |
| CO2 | 10600 | 0.117 | 943.4 | 28.3 |

## Spectrum viewer

A client-side, multi-trace spectrum plotter with paired wavelength/energy axes (selectable nm, eV, or cm⁻¹):

- "Spectrum type" toggle switches between absorption and steady-state fluorescence — the Y axis relabels to Fluorescence Intensity (a.u.) and the illustrative demo switches to a Stokes-shifted emission curve; every other feature works identically in both modes.
- Load multiple spectra and overlay them, or give each an independent Y offset to stack them waterfall-style.
- Load data via the built-in illustrative demo, CSV upload, or pasting columns copied straight from a spreadsheet — a wide-format file (wavelength plus several sample columns) automatically splits into one spectrum per column. Uploading or pasting real data automatically removes any leftover demo spectrum, so it never lingers alongside real traces.
- New spectra are auto-assigned colors from the colorblind-safe Okabe-Ito palette, overridable per trace with a color picker, and each trace can be drawn solid, dashed, or dotted (useful for figures that will be printed in grayscale).
- Customizable chart title, per-trace legend labels, X/Y axis min/max/tick step, independent X/Y gridline toggles, background color (transparent/white/theme/custom), and a closed axis box (top/right border + mirrored ticks, on by default) matching the GraphPad Prism convention.
- The chart canvas stays pinned (sticky) while scrolling through the data rows and settings below it, so edits show live without losing sight of the plot.
- Export the chart as a vector SVG (for Illustrator/Inkscape) or PNG, export each spectrum's raw underlying data as CSV converted to nm/eV/cm⁻¹, or export a single combined CSV of exactly what's currently visible on screen (respecting hidden traces, Y offsets, and any custom X-axis crop). "Clear all" removes every loaded spectrum at once.
- "Save project (.json)" downloads every loaded spectrum plus all chart settings as one local file; "Load project" reads it straight back in later, on any device — a complete save/reopen workflow with no account or server involved.

No account or upload to a server is required for any of this.

## Pages

- [Converter, spectrum viewer, and reference tables](https://spectrawave.vercel.app/): interactive calculator, multi-spectrum absorption/fluorescence plotter, full laser reference table, and an educational guide explaining the wavelength-to-energy relationship, why energy scales nonlinearly with wavelength, and how to build a publication-ready spectrum figure.
